learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the beautiful and magical connection between still stone sculptures and flowing, graceful dancers in Indian art!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: If you look closely at ancient Indian temples, you will see beautiful stone carvings of dancers. These sculptures are like photographs from the past, freezing a perfect, graceful dance move forever in solid rock!

Just as sculptures capture a dancer's pose, dancers are like living, breathing sculptures. When a dancer pauses during a performance, their body creates a perfect, beautiful shape just like a masterfully carved statue.
Both dancers and sculptors use the exact same language of hand gestures, called Mudras, and body postures, called Bhangas, to tell magical stories of gods, heroes, and nature.

fun_activity.title: 🗿 The Statue Freeze Dance
fun_activity.instructions: Play your favorite energetic song and dance wildly around the room. Have a friend or parent pause the music suddenly, and you must freeze instantly into a beautiful, solid statue pose!

quick_recap: ⭐ Sculptures and dancers beautifully share the exact same poses and hand gestures to tell ancient stories.
⭐ Dancers act as living sculptures, while stone carvings preserve the magic of dance forever.
